title: Reacquire cold-node authority under pressure
statement: Under deterministic control-plane pressure a durable non-seed restart reaches recovery-ready with full admin reachable inside the bounded restart budget by consuming canonical startup authority through retained eligible bootstrap routes. The reference rolling-restart validation reports neither admin_reachability_refused nor control_snapshot_authority_unavailable.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Preserve one canonical startup/control-snapshot authority. Alternate bootstrap endpoints may proxy, redirect, or return verifiable canonical evidence; they must not mint topology or reconstruct authority from cache, durable hints, probe success, or diagnostics.

A short reachability probe is a routing hint, not authority proof. Probe failure must retain the complete eligible durable candidate set and its ordering/freshness evidence for bounded contact attempts; it must not collapse multi-peer knowledge to one explicit seed or one recovered peer.

Restart admission and bootstrap work use the shared pressure contract with bounded critical capacity. Insufficient headroom must surface before restart as restart_capacity_not_available, or during contact as a bounded seed_contact_pressure outcome with retry/budget context; timeout-only silence is not an outcome.

Keep the full SQL/admin surface gated behind successful infrastructure join. The bootstrap surface must remain reachable and expose read-only early diagnostics for candidate set, current candidate, attempt number, last outcome, remaining budget, and authority source.

Route contacting_seed plus admin_reachability_refused to startup_authority_consumption or restart_bootstrap_authority. If the active-gate snapshot phase was not reached, report snapshot coverage as target_not_reached or unknown rather than failed.

Before production changes, add a deterministic in-process red-on-revert reproduction at the candidate-routing and authority-consumption boundary: global publication/coverage green, primary contact delayed by injected pressure, durable alternate candidates retained, and either bounded reacquisition succeeds or the canonical typed pressure outcome is emitted.

The immutable reference artifact is test-output/reports/rolling-restart-seed-join-authoritative-refresh-live-9bc66278-run1.report.json. A live run is not the iteration loop; if a hot retry/recovery/failure-classification path changes, closure also requires the repository-mandated controlled live A/B with fixed node count, workload, failure schedule, clean-start protocol, and source fingerprint.
Do not increase the 120-second recovery budget, weaken authority/readiness checks, start full SQL admin before join, reduce load to recreate a historical pass, or add a snapshot-coverage exception.

Closure must cover the owner path plus direct and tail consumers: restart admission, bootstrap candidate routing, startup-authority consumption, bootstrap diagnostics, admin/harness reachability classification, analyzer routing, and deletion of superseded singleton/fallback vocabulary.
